purpose: Tag 标签; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandTag](../../lib/src/components/tag.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Controlled values are authoritative. Component owns only focus, hover, preview, motion and explicitly uncontrolled state.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win. Optional parent activation reconciles semantic DOM blur only for the same still-mounted independently focusable child in the resumed view; explicit external focus and disposal win. No opaque child content/style is inspected or rewritten. A pending presentation-focus recovery survives benign host/theme rebuilds while its child/header owner is unchanged. New recovery ownership supersedes the previous request; replacement, removal, disposal, inactive view and explicit external destinations retain priority. Rebuilding alone does not cancel an otherwise valid request. Independent Card/Tag/Table child focus attaches to the existing caller Focus node, including a FocusScope; if no inherited focus exists it uses the existing manager root. A scope boundary must not silently place the child beneath the optional parent detector or paint parent focus over child focus. One shared ActionSurface owns this fork; no new scope or copied child subtree is introduced.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required. Passive and disabled controls do not advertise tap actions.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Transparent variants use surface ink; filled variants use fixed pairs. Foreground/fill changes are atomic; transform/shadow motion remains. Main and close actions have independent two-tone focus. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. The close mark is the reference14px multiplication-sign glyph, not a Material icon; its accessible name remains owned by the close action. Close hover pairs colorway.ink with colorway.soft atomically, including transparent variants under dark hosts; resting close inherits the Tag foreground. This owned graphic retains3.0 against its actual fill, independent of explicit child styling. The close color switch is immediate; the parent retains200ms transform/shadow motion. Known owned surfaces reuse LightSurfaceScope with a component-supplied paired foreground for nested public controls; no background guessing or child rewriting. Scope topology stays stable on filled/transparent Tag changes. Explicit child styles, unrelated ThemeExtensions, keys, state and focus remain authoritative. Custom backgrounds require a caller-owned suitable foreground. The fixed foundation paired foregrounds also cover nested text-button pressed beige and ghost-button8% mint hover composition. Nine onAccent, seven Title and three patterned-paper foreground entries were deepened after396 measured failing frame checks across1092 recipes; fills, hover overlays and motion are retained. The complete old/new pairs and actual backings are registered under A11Y-023; static default contrast is not a substitute for these state checks. Same-frame backing/ink sampling authority: docs/DESIGN.md#surface-sampling. Green soft text and its hovered close glyph use the restored shared colorway ink. Lime/yellow-green filled surfaces and their nested semantic defaults use shared onAccent; all variants retain the same child and independent close action. Actual close backgrounds and nested text-action pressed surfaces remain part of the contrast contract. This component consumes its declared shared roles; fixed-pair decisions have one authority at docs/DESIGN.md#shared-accent-foreground. Dashed strokes use the single public foundation painter under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke. This component retains its existing shape, color, width, dash/gap, state and content ownership; no second contour loop or consumer-private import.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.
